index.text1: Hello! Welcome to an unofficial Limbus Company guide website, here we will teach you the game using a similar UI to the real thing, but replacing the gameplay aspects with explanations and showcases.
index.text2: Incase you are unaware of what Limbus Company is, it's a 2D turn based,story, gacha game and is the 3rd game within the Project Moon universe (a prequel to Lobotomy Corp and Library Of Ruina)
index.text3: As the Executive Manager of Limbus Company, lead your group of twelve Sinners, venture into the buried facilities of Lobotomy Corporation, and lay claim on the Golden Boughs.
